# tu 1.1.4 — a button row for every width

## What's new since `v1.1.3`

- **Responsive button row.** The six buttons pick the widest form
  that fits the terminal, and the shortcut is always in yellow:
  `New (n) … Delete (Bksp)` at 91+ cells, `New … Cancel Esc` at 71+
  (an 80-column pane), bordered keys only (`N A R D Esc Bksp`) at
  40+, and bare keys in each button's own colour below that, where
  focus and hover still fill the cell.
- **Quieter status row.** The "Inside tmux · …" / "Outside tmux · …"
  idle text is gone; the row stays empty until an action reports
  something, and the update note has it to itself.
- **Release pipeline.** The `release` workflow now updates the
  Homebrew tap and publishes to crates.io itself, so `brew upgrade tu`
  and `cargo install tmux-tu` see a new version minutes after the tag.

## Install

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hungryZoo/tu/main/install.sh | sh
```

Already on 1.1.3? Press **u** in `tu`.
